purpose: Evidence-ready working file for LORE Crypto History.
progress_note: 10 core/canonical 2025 events verified. Deep-cut research remains for corporate treasury copycats, tokenized asset growth, additional ETPs and ecosystem-specific culture.

entries.title: MicroStrategy rebrands as Strategy around its Bitcoin treasury identity
entries.summary: MicroStrategy announced that it would do business as Strategy, unveiling a stylized Bitcoin 'B' logo and orange brand color while describing itself as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury Company.
entries.significance: The rebrand made Bitcoin accumulation so central to a long-established public company that it became the company's primary corporate identity.

entries.title: Bybit suffers the largest publicly reported crypto theft to date
entries.summary: Attackers compromised a Bybit Ethereum cold-wallet signing workflow and stole roughly $1.46-$1.5 billion in ETH and liquid-staking assets. The FBI attributed the theft to North Korean TraderTraitor actors.
entries.significance: The Bybit theft eclipsed previous crypto heists in reported dollar value and showed that sophisticated signing-interface attacks could compromise even cold-wallet operational processes.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

entries.title: United States establishes a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
entries.summary: A US executive order directed Treasury to establish a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve initially capitalized with finally forfeited government BTC and stated that BTC deposited into the reserve should not be sold except as permitted by the order and applicable law.
entries.significance: A government that had historically auctioned seized Bitcoin formally created a policy to retain forfeited BTC as a reserve asset.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Executive Order

entries.title: United States establishes a separate Digital Asset Stockpile
entries.summary: The same executive order created a United States Digital Asset Stockpile for finally forfeited digital assets other than Bitcoin and distinguished its acquisition and management rules from the Bitcoin Reserve.
entries.significance: The policy formally separated Bitcoin from other government-held digital assets and created a new federal framework for managing forfeited crypto holdings.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order

entries.title: Ethereum Pectra upgrade activates
entries.summary: Pectra activated at epoch 364,032, introducing EIP-7702 smart-account functionality for EOAs, validator improvements including a higher maximum effective balance, and increased blob capacity.
entries.significance: Pectra was one of Ethereum's largest bundles of protocol changes and advanced wallet UX, staking efficiency and rollup scaling.

entries.title: Coinbase joins the S&P 500
entries.summary: Coinbase Global was added to the S&P 500 before the opening of trading on 19 May 2025.
entries.significance: A crypto-native exchange becoming a constituent of the flagship US large-cap equity index marked a major step in cryptocurrency industry's integration into public-market infrastructure.

sources.title: S&P Dow Jones Indices — Coinbase Global Set to Join S&P 500

entries.title: Circle begins trading on the NYSE
entries.summary: Circle Internet Group priced an upsized IPO at $31 per share and its Class A common stock began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker CRCL on 5 June 2025.
entries.significance: The public listing brought the issuer of USDC, one of crypto's dominant stablecoins, directly into US public equity markets.

entries.title: GENIUS Act becomes US federal stablecoin law
entries.summary: The President signed S. 1582, the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act, into law on 18 July 2025.
entries.significance: The law created the first dedicated US federal statutory framework for payment stablecoins, moving stablecoin oversight from fragmented guidance toward explicit legislation.

entries.title: SEC permits in-kind creations and redemptions for crypto ETPs
entries.summary: The SEC approved orders allowing authorized participants to create and redeem Bitcoin and Ether ETP shares in kind rather than being limited to cash-only processes.
entries.significance: The change brought crypto ETP mechanics closer to conventional commodity ETPs and reduced a structural inefficiency of the 2024 spot-product approvals.

sources.title: SEC — In-Kind Creations and Redemptions for Crypto ETPs

entries.title: Ethereum Fusaka upgrade activates PeerDAS
entries.summary: Fusaka activated at epoch 411,392, introducing Peer Data Availability Sampling alongside execution and consensus changes designed to increase blob throughput and improve Ethereum scaling.
entries.significance: PeerDAS changed how Ethereum nodes verify rollup data availability and enabled a major expansion of blob capacity without requiring every node to download every blob.
